# Daily Briefing – Monday, 20 July

Yesterday was a rest day with light movement — 6,136 steps and 2,383 kcal burned, so your metabolism is ticking along nicely even without structured training. The one concern is sleep: 3.9 hours is significantly below what your body needs right now, and that'll have a real knock-on effect.

Your HRV tells the story clearly — 85ms against your 101–119ms baseline is a meaningful dip, almost certainly driven by that poor sleep. Stress at 32/100 is reassuringly low, so this isn't burnout. Today, keep any planned session easy — think light aerobic work or a walk. Don't push intensity until your HRV recovers toward baseline.

Prioritise sleep tonight above everything else — it's your biggest recovery lever right now. Also hit your 175g protein target today; it supports muscle repair even on rest days and helps regulate sleep hormones. You've got this! 💪
